name: AdGuardHome-Sync
description: Synchronize AdGuard Home configuration from one origin instance to one or more replica instances.

variables.name: Origin URL
variables.description: URL of the source AdGuard Home instance, for example http://192.168.1.10.

variables.name: Origin Username
variables.description: Username for the source AdGuard Home instance.

variables.name: Origin Password
variables.description: Password for the source AdGuard Home instance.

variables.name: Replica 1 URL
variables.description: URL of the first replica AdGuard Home instance, for example http://192.168.1.11.

variables.name: Replica 1 Username
variables.description: Username for the first replica AdGuard Home instance.

variables.name: Replica 1 Password
variables.description: Password for the first replica AdGuard Home instance.

variables.name: Cron Schedule
variables.description: Cron expression controlling how often synchronization runs. Default: every two hours.

variables.name: Run On Start
variables.description: Run a synchronization immediately when the container starts.

variables.name: API Port
variables.description: Port used by the web dashboard and API. Set to 0 to disable the API.

variables.name: Dark Mode
variables.description: Enable dark mode for the AdGuardHome-Sync web interface.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Logging level: debug, info, warn or error.

variables.name: Origin Skip TLS Verification
variables.description: Disable TLS certificate verification for the origin instance. Leave false unless required.

variables.name: Replica 1 Skip TLS Verification
variables.description: Disable TLS certificate verification for the first replica. Leave false unless required.
